name: Quedate Jugando
description: Montevideo shop selling board games, card games, puzzles, outdoor games and stationery such as agendas and notebooks, and publishing a few games of its own. Ships to the whole country and offers free pickup at its Montevideo store.
description_es: Tienda de Montevideo que vende juegos de mesa, juegos de cartas, puzzles, juegos de aire libre y papelería como agendas y cuadernos, y edita algunos juegos propios. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro gratis en su local de Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Home delivery in Montevideo and Canelones with cost shown at checkout; rest of the country by agency with cost calculated at checkout. No delivery times stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at the Montevideo store, weekday and Saturday morning hours stated on the shipping page.

shopping_notes: Prices show a transfer price alongside the list price. Checkout is at /checkout.
